concept.reason: Original skull figures, museum mount and comparative skeleton sufficient; no extra concepts.

scope: Whole living large pampathere with broad armored back, three flexible central bands and long narrow head.

scientific_limits.en: UF890 partial skull dimensions do not measure a whole living individual; premaxillae, zygomatic arches and parts of occiput/ventral skull are missing. Whole body scale and soft tissues are reconstruction estimates. Museum mount restoration extent unknown. LPP-PV-001 H.cryptae skeleton is comparative only: 2025 osteoderm study questions its generic placement and calls for cranial reassessment, not a confirmed transfer. Do not combine its measured 2.2m axial length with UF890 as one specimen. Skin color, ears and exact toe soft tissue inferred.
scientific_limits.zh: UF890部分颅实测不是完整活体尺寸，前颌、颧弓及部分枕/腹面缺失。全体比例和软组织为复原估计，展架修复程度不明。LPP-PV-001 cryptae仅比较；2025甲片研究对其属归属提出疑问并要求颅骨复核，不是已确定改属。其2.2米轴长不与UF890合称同个体实测。颜色、耳和趾软组织为推断。

scale.species_report: University of Florida1997 reports H.septentrionalis more than6ft long, a species estimate.
scale.model_status: All model dimensions original estimates, not same-specimen measurements; total2.2m not adopted as H.cryptae measurement.

diagnostic_targets: Long relatively narrow tapering head, low triangular snout, small eyes and cephalic armor; not blunt glyptodont face or anteater tube.
Broad elongated moderately domed carapace formed by distinct shoulder and pelvic bucklers, not one spherical turtle shell.
Exactly three transverse movable central bands between bucklers; distinguish boundary semimovable rows from those three bands.
Polygonal buckler scutes with raised central regions and depressed perimeter, elongated rectangular overlapping band scutes. Low-poly grouped geometry not hundreds of separate blocks.
Four sturdy short clawed limbs, feet below side armor with clear ground contact; no hooves or flippers.
Tapering armored tail without a club or spikes; neutral inferred skin and tiny ears, no glyptodont giant ball shell.
acceptance: Original full body, broad back, three flexible middle bands and long narrow head all legible.
Top/side distinguish three movable bands and two continuous bucklers; armor is geometry, not flat painted stripe.
Front/perspective retain narrow projecting snout and sturdy separated supports.
Scale metadata separates UF890 measurement, species estimate and original living reconstruction.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
